note: Candidate batch order mapped onto the sample project's folders. Not final until the user confirms the screen list at H1. Folders are relative to project.json ui_root.
screenRule: Candidates are every .prefab under the folders. Names ending in View, Popup or UI are 'screen candidates'; anything else (Unit, Button, Frame, Bar ...) is a 'part'. A part nested (PrefabInstance) inside a screen candidate of the same batch is marked 'included'.
